description: Language-agnostic vectors of the extruded solid's `sweep` (D47), hand-computed on the sample figure at 1:100 in the pose `stand`: the thigh bone `thigh-l` hangs down from the origin, so its u axis is world -y (down), its normal v is world +x (ahead) and its lateral axis w is world +z (left). One rect profile (x 0..0.45 along the bone, y 0..0.05) is swept from z0 = -0.2 to z1 = 0.3. sweep `w` puts the profile in the (u, v) plane and the thickness along w: front shows x = z0..z1 (the lateral span) and y = -0.45..0 (the profile along the bone); plan shows x = 0..0.05 (the profile's second axis, along v) and y = z0..z1. sweep `v` puts the profile in the (u, w) plane and the thickness along v: front shows x = 0..0.05 (the profile's second axis, along w) and y = -0.45..0, plan shows x = z0..z1 (the thickness along v, ahead) and y = 0..0.05. A longitudinal u sweep takes its (v, w) profile along the shaft axis. A missing sweep has no default and is refused.

cases.name: sweep u: a transverse (v, w) profile runs along the shaft
sweep w: the profile lies in the (u, v) plane and the thickness runs laterally
sweep v: the profile lies in the (u, w) plane and the thickness runs along the bone normal

lateralRest.description: The same slat on the same thigh, the thigh moved 0.1 m to the left in the rig (bone `z` 0.1). With sweep `w` the members `z0` / `z1` (and `zTip`) are lateral positions of the REST pose in asset coordinates (world z, left +), not offsets from the bone: the slat stays at -0.2..0.3 although its bone moved. With sweep `v` the span is measured from the bone origin along its normal v, and the second profile axis runs along w from the bone, so front and plan show it at 0.1..0.15.

depth.description: The depth a solid is ranked by for the paint order (`shapeDepth`): the nearest point of the profile carried at the middle of its span along the sweep axis, in the same placement that draws it. A rect profile (first coordinate 0..0.45, second 0.1..0.3) with the span -0.02..0.04 (middle 0.01) on the same hanging thigh (u down, v ahead, w left), relative to the bone origin: the front ranks by the position ahead (world x), the plan by the height (world y). sweep `u`: the profile lies in (v, w) and the span along u, so the foremost point is the profile's 0.45 along v and the highest the middle of the span, 0.01 below the origin. sweep `w`: the profile lies in (u, v), foremost 0.3 along v, highest at the origin. sweep `v`: the profile lies in (u, w) and the span along v, foremost the middle of the span 0.01, highest at the origin.
